_comment: LandfallElementals / Risen Reef (2026-10-18). The look-top LAND choice must be SEARCHED, and the card the Reef puts into hand must be playable the SAME turn (site-10 put-in-hand breakpoint). Board: 2 Mountains, Risen Reef (can attack: 1), Aether Vial on 1. Hand: Flamekin Harbinger, 3x Lightning Bolt, Gruul Turf (a tapped Karoo). Library top: Mountain, then dead Swords filler (no Elemental: Harbinger's search finds nothing, so the trigger order is moot). The only T4 kill (opponent at 9): Vial the Harbinger in for free -> the Reef looks at the Mountain -> put it into HAND -> play it as the land drop -> 3 R -> three Bolts = 9. The provider's DEFAULT for the look is BATTLEFIELD (a land -- the Gruul Turf -- is already in hand), which leaves 2 R: two Bolts + the Reef's 1 = 7 and no win this turn; casting the Harbinger from hand instead of with the Vial nets no mana; not using the Reef at all is 2 Bolts + 1. So the fixture passes only if the land pin's HAND variant is enumerated, applied, and its continuation plays the Mountain.
